breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The original prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions, specifying both Dirichlet and periodic types. The agent correctly resolved this by removing the periodic condition and only specifying the Dirichlet conditions (u(0,t) = 1 and u(1,t) = 0), which matches the ground truth.
